_doc: Owned per-state wear weights (wear.py), the Second Wind's scale: 0 = none, 1 = its derelict ceiling. The Manticore (P), a pirate destroyer that opens the Asharu fight: `battle` is what the build ships, the same row as the Colossus Mk.III (`battle`) and near the Kite (P), Falcon (P) and Hound (P) (`pirate`), so the pirate fleet wears one standard: scuffed and pitted, the scarlet overpaint faded, heavy grime and soot round five drives, never properly maintained.
